h: MTN launches MTN One TV streaming service with Nigerian original series
p: MTN has introduced MTN One TV, an ad-supported streaming platform to compete with Netflix and others. Its first original is a Nigerian series, 100 Ways to Stay Single in Lagos.
body: Telecommunications giant MTN has launched MTN One TV, an advertising-supported streaming service aimed at African audiences, as it takes on global platforms such as Netflix, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV.
The service is designed to give viewers access to local entertainment and original productions, and is expected to eventually include free-to-air television channels.
MTN has unveiled 100 Ways to Stay Single in Lagos, a Nigerian-produced series featuring actors from Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. It is the platform's first original series.
The move signals MTN's ambition to become more than a mobile network provider, as competition for viewers in Africa's growing streaming market increases.
more: Its first original is 100 Ways to Stay Single in Lagos.
It will compete with Netflix and Disney+.
